jina: Short title, commencement and application of this Constitution
maudhui: (1) This Constitution may be cited as the Constitution of the United Republic of Tanzania, 1977. (2) This Constitution shall come into operation on the twenty-sixth day of April, 1977. (3) This Constitution shall apply to Mainland Tanzania as well as Tanzania Zanzibar.
vifungu: (1) This Constitution may be cited as the Constitution of the United Republic of Tanzania, 1977.
(2) This Constitution shall come into operation on the twenty-sixth day of April, 1977.
(3) This Constitution shall apply to Mainland Tanzania as well as Tanzania Zanzibar.
